question: Which publications report defect passivation strategies that improve the moisture stability of halide perovskite solar cells?

records.title: Defect passivation for moisture-stable halide perovskite solar cells
records.abstract: We introduce a molecular defect passivation layer that heals undercoordinated lead sites at the halide perovskite surface. Devices retain 94% of initial efficiency after 1000 h at 85% relative humidity, demonstrating that defect passivation directly improves the moisture stability of perovskite solar cells.

records.title: Moisture-induced degradation mechanisms in halide perovskite films
records.abstract: Operando spectroscopy reveals how moisture ingress drives hydrate formation and lattice collapse in halide perovskite thin films under elevated humidity. The degradation pathway is mapped as a function of film composition and grain size.

records.title: Ion migration hysteresis in mixed-cation thin-film photovoltaic devices
records.abstract: We combine drift-diffusion modelling and impedance spectroscopy to show that grain-boundary passivation of mobile ionic defects suppresses current-voltage hysteresis in mixed-cation thin-film photovoltaic devices over a wide temperature range.

records.title: Kinetic study of methane dry reforming over nickel-ceria catalysts
records.abstract: Reaction rates and carbon deposition were measured for co-precipitated Ni/CeO2 catalysts between 873 and 973 K in a fixed-bed reactor. A Langmuir-Hinshelwood model fits the measured kinetics across the full temperature range.
